title: Do You Dare to Try Chinese Liquor?
synopsis: Learn about China’s unique drinking culture.

fullText.simplified:
你敢挑战中国的白酒吗？

    “朋友来了有好酒”一直是中国人最直接、最热情的待客方式。
    据说，酒在中国有几千多年的历史了。它和丝绸、瓷器一样，都是中国文化的代表元素。就连各个朝代的皇帝们都是酒忠实的粉丝。2013年3月，外媒评出了世界十大最爱喝酒的国家，排在第一位的是英国，中国排名第二。
    随着各国之间的友好发展，经济、政治等交流频繁，来往更加密切。来中国发展的外国友人也越来越多了。尤其是商务往来，喝点酒必不可少。今天就给大家介绍一些喝中国白酒的小讲究。
    中国的白酒一般度数比较高，但是入口并没有伏特加浓浓的酒精味。相反，很多酒喝下去都是柔柔的，但后劲却很足。所以白酒不能大口喝下去，需要一小口一小口慢慢地喝。不了解的外国朋友，初次尝试，往往还会像在自己的国家一样，一口喝光。结果度数太高，让他们感觉咳都咳不出来，非常痛苦，甚至有的人评价中国的酒就像汽油一样呛人。
    喝酒要小口，跟别人干杯也是有讲究的。碰杯的时候，应该让自己的酒杯低于对方的酒杯，表示你对对方的尊敬。当你离对方比较远时，可以用酒杯杯底轻碰桌面，也表示和对方碰杯。
    除了上边提到的，还有敬酒顺序、敬酒词等中国的酒桌文化。俗话说：实践出真知。多来中国几次，多跟中国朋友喝几次酒，很快就学会了！
fullText.traditional:
你敢挑戰中國的白酒嗎？

    “朋友來了有好酒”一直是中國人最直接、最熱情的待客方式。
    據說，酒在中國有幾千多年的歷史了。它和絲綢、瓷器一樣，都是中國文化的代表元素。就連各個朝代的皇帝們都是酒忠實的粉絲。2013年3月，外媒評出了世界十大最愛喝酒的國家，排在第一位的是英國，中國排名第二。
    隨著各國之間的友好發展，經濟、政治等交流頻繁，來往更加密切。來中國發展的外國友人也越來越多了。尤其是商務往來，喝點酒必不可少。今天就給大家介紹一些喝中國白酒的小講究。
    中國的白酒一般度數比較高，但是入口並沒有伏特加濃濃的酒精味。相反，很多酒喝下去都是柔柔的，但後勁卻很足。所以白酒不能大口喝下去，需要一小口一小口慢慢地喝。不了解的外國朋友，初次嘗試，往往還會像在自己的國家一樣，一口喝光。結果度數太高，讓他們感覺咳都咳不出來，非常痛苦，甚至有的人評價中國的酒就像汽油一樣嗆人。
    喝酒要小口，跟別人乾杯也是有講究的。碰杯的時候，應該讓自己的酒杯低于對方的酒杯，表示你對對方的尊敬。當你離對方比較遠時，可以用酒杯杯底輕碰桌面，也表示和對方碰杯。
    除了上邊提到的，還有敬酒順序、敬酒詞等中國的酒桌文化。俗話說：實踐出真知。多來中國幾次，多跟中國朋友喝幾次酒，很快就學會了！

sentences.english: On the contrary, many drinks are mild when you drink them, but have a very strong aftereffect.

sentences.english: When foreigners who do not know this try Chinese liquor for the first time, ..

sentences.simplified: 结果度数太高，让他们感觉咳都咳不出来，

sentences.english: .. often they will down it all in one go like they would in their own countries.

sentences.traditional: 非常痛苦，甚至有的人評價中國的酒就像汽油一樣嗆人。

sentences.english: Because the alcohol content is too high, people feel like they can’t even cough it out.
This causes a lot of discomfort, and there are even people who say that Chinese liquor is as unpleasant as gasoline.

sentences.simplified: 喝酒要小口，跟别人干杯也是有讲究的。
sentences.traditional: 喝酒要小口，跟別人乾杯也是有講究的。

sentences.traditional: 碰杯的時候，應該讓自己的酒杯低于對方的酒杯，表示你對對方的尊敬。

sentences.english: When you clink glasses with someone, you should hold your glass lower than the other person’s glass to show respect.

sentences.traditional: 可以用酒杯杯底輕碰桌面，也表示和對方碰杯。

sentences.english: If you are sitting far from the other person, ..
.. you can lightly tap your glass on the table to represent clinking glasses with them.

sentences.traditional: 俗話說：實踐出真知。
sentences.pinyin: sú huà shuō shí jiàn chū zhēn zhī
sentences.english: .. Chinese drinking culture also includes the order of toasting and the toasts themselves.

sentences.traditional: 多來中國幾次，多跟中國朋友喝幾次酒，很快就學會了！

sentences.english: As the saying goes, experience is the mother of wisdom.
Come to China more often, drink with your Chinese friends more often, and you will master this art in no time!

raw.synopsis: Learn about China’s unique drinking culture.
sentence_translations: Do You Dare to Try Chinese Liquor?
“We welcome friends with good wine” has always been the most direct and enthusiastic way for Chinese people to show their hospitality.
It is said that the history of Chinese liquor can be traced back thousands of years.
Like silk and porcelain, it is a very representative element of Chinese culture.
Even the emperors during various dynasties were faithful fans of liquor.
In March 2013, foreign media chose the top ten countries that consume the most alcohol.
The UK ranked first, and China ranked second.
In the wake of the development of friendly relations between different countries, ..
.. economic and political exchanges have become more frequent, and interactions have become closer.
The number of foreigners coming to China to develop their careers is increasing.
In particular, for business interactions, drinking a little alcohol is essential.
Today we would like to introduce everyone to the art of drinking Chinese liquor.
Generally speaking, Chinese liquor has high alcohol content.
But, when it enters the mouth, it does not have a strong taste of alcohol like vodka does.
On the contrary, many drinks are mild when you drink them, but have a very strong aftereffect.
This is why Chinese liquor should not be drunk in large gulps; it should be drunk slowly in small sips.
When foreigners who do not know this try Chinese liquor for the first time, ..
.. often they will down it all in one go like they would in their own countries.
Because the alcohol content is too high, people feel like they can’t even cough it out.
This causes a lot of discomfort, and there are even people who say that Chinese liquor is as unpleasant as gasoline.
Chinese liquor needs to be sipped. There are also rules to pay attention to when toasting others.
When you clink glasses with someone, you should hold your glass lower than the other person’s glass to show respect.
If you are sitting far from the other person, ..
.. you can lightly tap your glass on the table to represent clinking glasses with them.
In addition to what was mentioned above, ..
.. Chinese drinking culture also includes the order of toasting and the toasts themselves.
As the saying goes, experience is the mother of wisdom.
Come to China more often, drink with your Chinese friends more often, and you will master this art in no time!
